column1: # Reviewed semantic identities for the GAME player progression, stat-recalculation, magic, weapon, and equipment family.
# Every row was checked with kf sema addr/disasm --blocks/xref/strings, Ghidra candidates, decoded callers/callees,
# adjacent boundaries, source/history/match state, and FID/vendor controls. This is a call-graph and shared-state
# campaign, not a translation-unit ownership claim; attack/defense component lore remains deliberately numbered.

column6: 44 CFG blocks rebuild effective physical power, magic, five attack components, and six defense/resistance values; weapon and armor loops, an eleven-case accessory switch, status modifiers, caps, and three notification paths are all represented
column7: reads base stats, status flags, weapon/armor/accessory IDs and records; writes the effective stat block; calls the message helper three times; the switch table is player_combat_stat_effect_jump_table; no strings

column9: absent from vendored/FID inventories; equipment records, player status policy, and the accessory switch are game-owned
column12: supported behavior and state ownership; individual attack/defense lane meanings and original TU remain unresolved
